Wed, 30 Sep 2026 23:41:52 +0000 en-US hourly 1 https://wordpress.org/?v=7.1.2 https://beesayatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/cropped-09-32x32.png News – beesayatv https://beesayatv.com/ 32 32 El Niño Intensifies: What Hikers Should Prepare For https://beesayatv.com/el-nino-intensifies-what-hikers-should-prepare-for/ Wed, 30 Sep 2026 23:40:17 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1759

The Climate Change Commission (CCC) is urging government agencies, schools and communities to strengthen preparations for El Niño as dry conditions are expected to intensify across the Philippines.

The advisory follows PAGASA’s warning that the current strong El Niño could develop into a very strong event between September and December 2026 and persist through the first half of 2027.

PAGASA said El Niño generally brings warmer temperatures and below-normal rainfall, increasing the risk of prolonged dry spells, drought and pressure on water resources. Short periods of heavy rainfall may still occur because of the southwest monsoon and tropical cyclones.

For hikers, prolonged dry conditions may mean hotter trails, reduced water flow in rivers and waterfalls, drier vegetation and fewer reliable natural water sources.

Hikers should carry more drinking water than usual, start early to avoid the hottest part of the day, check PAGASA and local advisories before leaving, and avoid relying on streams or springs that may normally provide water. Extra caution is also advisable in dry grasslands and forest areas where fire risk may increase.

Impasugong Trail 42 is scheduled for November 14–15, 2026, at CEDAR in Impalutao, Impasugong, Bukidnon.

The trail-running event features three race categories: 42K, 21K, and 15K, taking runners through the municipality’s rolling grasslands, forested areas, mountain trails, and other natural landscapes.

The 42K category includes a finisher medal, event shirt, race bib with timing chip, aid-station refreshments, and CEDAR entrance fee. The 21K and 15K categories also include race entitlements, with optional add-ons available for selected items.

Impasugong is known for its highland scenery and outdoor destinations, making the event an opportunity for runners to experience some of Bukidnon’s mountain terrain and countryside.

The event is organized by Pace & Peak, with complete race information and registration details available through the official Impasugong Trail 42 event listing.

Website: https://paceandpeak.com/etn/impasugong-trail-42/

]]> Asturias Trail Quest 2026 Set for December 6 in Cebu https://beesayatv.com/asturias-trail-quest-2026-set-for-december-6-in-cebu/ Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:28:54 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1731

Asturias Trail Quest 2026 is scheduled for December 6, 2026, at Cebu Technological University – Asturias in Asturias, Cebu.

The event features three trail-running categories: 30K, 15K, and 8K, with registration fees of ₱2,500, ₱2,000, and ₱1,500, respectively.

The race highlights the natural landscapes, agricultural communities, rivers, and cultural heritage of Asturias, offering runners an opportunity to experience the municipality beyond its roads and town center.

Gun starts are scheduled for 2:30 AM for the 30K, 4:30 AM for the 15K, and 5:30 AM for the 8K.

Participants are required to submit a medical certificate declaring them fit to run and comply with the organizer’s race regulations.

Registration and complete event details are available through the official Asturias Trail Quest 2026 listing on Dromos.

For more information: https://dromosevents.com/events/asturias-trail-quest-2026-2026-12-06

]]> DENR Closes Spartan Trail in Cebu Until Further Notice https://beesayatv.com/denr-closes-spartan-trail-in-cebu-until-further-notice/ Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:57:28 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1649

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has officially closed the Spartan Trail within the Central Cebu Protected Landscape until further notice.

Issued on September 21, 2026, the closure order allows authorities to investigate reported environmental violations and carry out necessary rehabilitation work in the area. Under Republic Act 9486 and Republic Act 11038, all entry, hiking, trekking, and recreational activities are strictly prohibited. Only authorized personnel involved in enforcement, monitoring, and rehabilitation are permitted to enter.

Hikers and visitors are advised to consider the Spartan Trail completely off-limits, avoid alternative entry points, and wait for an official reopening notice from authorities before planning future trips.

]]> El Niño Is Strengthening — What It Could Mean for Cebu’s Mountains and Trails https://beesayatv.com/el-nino-is-strengthening-what-it-could-mean-for-cebus-mountains-and-trails/ Sat, 19 Sep 2026 23:26:43 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1644

A strong El Niño is currently established across the tropical Pacific and is projected to intensify further over the coming months.

According to PAGASA and the World Meteorological Organization, moderate to strong conditions are expected to reach very strong intensity by late 2026, with a high likelihood of persisting into early 2027.

For Cebu and the broader Philippines, this climate event typically triggers below-normal rainfall, dry spells, and potential drought, though localized rain and Habagat showers remain possible.

Hikers and local residents in Cebu’s uplands should anticipate hotter and drier trail conditions, drying vegetation, and reduced water levels in mountain streams as the dry conditions progress.

]]> Budlaan Tragedy a Reminder of River Risks for Cebu Hikers https://beesayatv.com/budlaan-tragedy-a-reminder-of-river-risks-for-cebu-hikers/ Fri, 18 Sep 2026 23:52:53 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1637

A nine-year-old boy was swept away by flash floods in Barangay Budlaan, Cebu City, on September 15 following heavy rainfall. The incident occurred in Sitio Gawad Kalinga, and search teams recovered his body downstream in Mandaue City the following morning.

This tragedy serves as a critical warning for Cebu hikers and outdoor enthusiasts. Mountain creeks, rivers, and drainage channels can transform into violent torrents within minutes, even if the heavy rain is falling upstream rather than at the trailhead.

When exploring Cebu’s upland trails, always check weather conditions across the entire surrounding watershed, and strictly avoid crossing swollen streams or narrow channels during and immediately after heavy rain.

]]> Very Unhealthy PM2.5 Levels Raise Outdoor Concerns in Cebu https://beesayatv.com/very-unhealthy-pm2-5-levels-raise-outdoor-concerns-in-cebu/ Fri, 18 Sep 2026 23:21:19 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1632

Elevated PM2.5 levels and persistent haze are raising outdoor safety concerns across Cebu. Fine particulate matter can penetrate deep into the lungs, making strenuous outdoor activities like hiking, trail running, and cycling particularly risky during high concentrations.

Air quality in Metro Cebu has fluctuated sharply, reaching “Very Unhealthy” and “Acutely Unhealthy” categories.The spike prompted the DENR Environmental Management Bureau to advise limiting prolonged outdoor exposure and wearing N95 or KN95 masks when outside.Severe haze also triggered class suspensions and reduced visibility across mountain ridges.

Because air conditions change throughout the day, outdoor enthusiasts are urged to check local real-time air quality index readings before heading out.Stay informed, limit physical exertion outdoors when levels spike, and prioritize safety.

]]> World Clean and Green Week Calls Attention to Protecting Outdoor Spaces https://beesayatv.com/world-clean-and-green-week-calls-attention-to-protecting-outdoor-spaces/ Fri, 18 Sep 2026 12:01:58 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1627

World Clean and Green Week, observed every September 17 to 23 under Presidential Proclamation No. 244, calls attention to protecting our outdoor spaces and natural environments.

Alongside September being designated as National Clean-Up Month, communities are encouraged to engage in recycling, composting, and waterway rehabilitation.

For hikers and outdoor enthusiasts, this observance serves as a vital reminder to pack out what you bring in, avoid damaging local vegetation, and leave trails and rivers pristine.

Protecting these natural spaces ensures they remain clean and worth exploring for years to come.

]]> Vandalism at Spartan Trail Raises Concerns Over Trail Protection https://beesayatv.com/vandalism-at-spartan-trail-raises-concerns-over-trail-protection/ Fri, 18 Sep 2026 05:03:54 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1620

Recent reports of vandalism along Cebu’s Spartan Trail have sparked growing concern among local hikers, trail runners, and conservation groups after photos surfaced showing writings and graffiti on trees, fallen logs, and concrete structures.

Because the route passes through a sensitive upland watershed landscape, the damage has renewed discussions on how to balance increasing trail popularity—driven largely by social media exposure—with effective protection and management.

While members of the outdoors community have raised the idea of temporary trail closures for rehabilitation, no official order from local authorities has been confirmed.

In response, visitors are being urged to strictly adhere to Leave No Trace principles by remaining on established paths, packing out garbage, and leaving all natural features untouched to prevent long-term environmental degradation.

]]> Metro Cebu Haze Reaches ‘Acutely Unhealthy’ Level https://beesayatv.com/metro-cebu-haze-reaches-acutely-unhealthy-level/ Thu, 03 Sep 2026 13:24:12 +0000 https://beesayatv.com/?p=1277

Metro Cebu’s air quality worsened on Thursday as haze from forest fires in Indonesia pushed fine particulate pollution into the “acutely unhealthy” level.

According to the Environmental Management Bureau (EMB), Metro Cebu’s PM2.5 Air Quality Index reached 252 at 11 a.m. on September 3, up from 241 earlier in the morning. The haze has been linked to smoke from forest fires in Kalimantan, Indonesia, carried toward Central Visayas by the southwest monsoon or Habagat.

The worsening conditions prompted Cebu City, Lapu-Lapu City, Talisay City, Carcar City and Minglanilla to suspend face-to-face classes, while authorities advised residents to limit outdoor exertion and avoid prolonged exposure to the polluted air.

For hikers, trail runners and other outdoor enthusiasts in Cebu, the current haze is especially important to monitor. Strenuous activities such as mountain hiking require heavier breathing and can increase exposure to the fine PM2.5 particles currently affecting the region.

Anyone planning to hike while the haze persists should check the latest air quality conditions before heading into the mountains and consider postponing strenuous outdoor activities when pollution remains at unhealthy levels.
